meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided on that mark, and when?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, then answer my question. Was Owen heard before that mark went in?
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here, Hale? Is there anything on Owen's record right now, and who else has seen this?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and confirmation in writing that nothing has been placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, and she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "tell me how I should handle this", because asking her to solve your problem made her respect you less and drew a fresh demand.
Try next time: when she first asked who decided on the mark and when, answer it directly and own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, since her own procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted first.
